messages:
alex chen: incident-bot just paged eng-oncall for a crashwave in us-west-2 runtime pool. containers on pool-runtimes-2 are crashlooping with SIGSEGV. seeing ~25% error rate for hosted API keys and a small spike in latency.
incident-bot: Pager: P1 runtime crashwave detected in us-west-2 (pool-runtimes-2). Error: SIGSEGV in inference-engine v2.3. Auto-escalation to oncall.
oncall-bot: Oncall rotation: @engoncall is the primary for the next 30m.
maria gonzalez: I'm on it. initial check: kube shows repeated CrashLoopBackOff on 6/40 pods in pool-runtimes-2. pods restart in ~10s. logs show `segfault at 0 ip` inside fused_kernel.so line with vLLM dispatch.
jordan li: can you paste the container logs?
maria gonzalez: sharing tail:```
2026-03-15T10:07:12Z runtime INFO starting serving loop
2026-03-15T10:07:13Z runtime ERROR caught signal SIGSEGV
2026-03-15T10:07:13Z runtime ERROR backtrace: fused_kernel::dispatch_impl+0x1a3
2026-03-15T10:07:13Z runtime ERROR address=0x0 pc=0x7f9a1c3b1234
2026-03-15T10:07:13Z runtime INFO creating core dump to /tmp/core.1234
```
samir: looks like null-deref in fused kernel path. any recent rollouts?
maria gonzalez: yes, we rolled model-serving image `inference:v2.3` 20m before the first crash. previous `v2.2` was stable.
alex chen: impact: hosted API error rate hit 27% for a handful of customers; several health checks flapping triggered internal alerting. customers on dedicated pools unaffected.
mika: tagging product: product-impact? which customers are hitting this?
jordan li: metrics show heavy traffic from org-eta and a couple of PLG trials. I'll message CS for heads-up.
engoncall: taking lead. immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) scale down deployments to 0 to stop churn 2) roll back to inference:v2.2 3) cordon + drain the 2 nodes that show OOM/killed logs 4) collect core dumps to s3.
maria gonzalez: doing step 1 now: `kubectl -n inference scale deploy/serve-runtime --replicas=0 --selector=pool=pool-runtimes-2`
alex chen: hold on on scale to 0 — traffic should fallback to fallback-pool per routing policy, but we need to confirm capacity. If fallback is saturated, customers will see errors.
mika: routing shows fallback-pool has ~60% headroom, OK for short window.
samir: while scaling, we should also push a temporary emergency image that disables fused-kernel optimizations to force CPU path. we have `inference:v2.3-no-fused` built last week.
jordan li: good call. that will avoid the segfault path. procedure: `kubectl set image deployment/serve-runtime inference=inference:v2.3-no-fused --record` then roll pods.
maria gonzalez: rolling now to `inference:v2.3-no-fused` on pool-runtimes-2, doing 1 pod at time. logs for new pods show stable startup.
incident-bot: Action logged: emergency roll to inference:v2.3-no-fused by maria gonzalez at 2026-03-15T10:22:45Z.
alex chen: good. start postmortem and tag infra/research. we need core dumps from the crashed pods for debugging. @mika can you grab the cores and upload?
mika: grabbing cores. command: `kubectl cp pod/serve-runtime-54:/tmp/core.1234 /tmp/core.1234` then `s3cmd put /tmp/core.1234 s3://redwood-cores/1843219876/`
engoncall: also collect `dmesg` and `nvidia-smi -q` or `sudo journalctl -k | tail -n 200` from nodes. there are hints of GPU driver page faults in node logs: `NVRM: Xid (0x4e) at 0 IP` on two nodes.
samir: driver Xid 0x4e is a GPU hang/timeout in some older driver revisions — but backtrace points to null deref inside our fused kernel shim. likely combined issue.
jordan li: has anyone opened a support ticket with the kernel/driver vendor? this might be multi-factor.
mika: files uploaded: core and node logs -> s3://redwood-cores/1843219876/ . I've added short_notes.txt listing pods and node IDs.
maria gonzalez: customer impact update: CS notified org-eta and two trials. error rate reduced to ~3% after emergency roll. latency back to normal for most customers.
alex chen: ops decision: keep pool on no-fused image until we ship a hotfix. schedule a canary in eu-west-1 to validate the fix before global rollout.
engoncall: creating incident ticket INC-1843219876 with links to cores and logs, assigning to eng-ml (samir) and eng-runtime (jordan).
samir: starting local reproduce with `inference:v2.3` on devbox with same driver stack and small QAT workload. already reproducing a segfault in fused_kernel::dispatch when sequence length spikes. sending gdb backtrace in thread.```
#0  0x00007f9a1c3b1234 in fused_kernel::dispatch_impl (this=0x0, args=...) at fused_kernel.cpp:412
#1  0x00007f9a1c3b2001 in fused_kernel::dispatch (args=...) at fused_kernel.cpp:110
#2  0x000055aa81ff6b2c in runtime::serve_loop()
```
jordan li: thanks. looks like `this` is null in dispatch_impl, need a guard. I can prepare a minimal hotfix that returns error instead of deref.
maria gonzalez: timeline notes for postmortem: 10:05 first errors, 10:12 pager, 10:20 emergency roll started, 10:25 roll completed, 10:30 errors dropped to baseline. patch planned for 12:00.
alex chen: for handoff: I'm ending my shift at 10:45. @jordan please coordinate the hotfix and handover to the next oncall @engoncall for overnight monitoring. leave runbook steps in incident ticket.
engoncall: will take over at 10:45. implementing a temporary monitor that alerts if error rate >5% for 5m. also adding eviction rule to avoid restarting pods more than 3 times in 10m.
mika: creating a private post for affected customers with an explanation and ETA.
incident-bot: Severity reduced to P2 by engoncall at 2026-03-15T11:02:00Z after rollback and mitigation.
jordan li: pushing hotfix branch `hotfix/null-guard-fused` with tests. deploying to canary eu-west-1 now.
samir: still investigating driver logs; will coordinate with infra next week if we see driver faults in other clusters.
alex chen: thanks all. final note: keep cores for 30 days, link to ticket in the postmortem, and schedule a blameless RCA with eng-runtime and eng-ml.
engoncall: handing off monitoring and post-incident tasks to night oncall. will update ticket with follow-ups.
maria gonzalez: thanks — closing the live mitigation thread. follow-up doc to be created in postmortems/.
